_meanings:
.²1 Opposition, obstruction, impediment.
.²2 Blockade, siege, investment.
.²3 Restraint, check.
.²4 Inconsistency, incongruity, contradiction; {#viroDo na vidyate brahmAdvitIyameva#}
 {#satyam .#} (--<ls>tripādvibhūtimahānārāyaṇopaniṣat 4. 2.</ls>)
.²5 Antithesis, contrast.
.²6 Enmity, hostility; {#viroDo viSrAntaH#} <ls>U. 6. 11</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 332</ls>; <ls>R. 10. 13</ls>.
.²7 A quarrel, disagreement.
.²8 A calamity, misfortune.
.²9 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) An apparent incongruity which is merely verbal and is explained
 away by properly construing the passage; it consists in representing objects
 as antithetical to one another though in the nature of things they are
 not so; representing things as being together though really they cannot
 be together; (this figure is largely used by Bāṇa and Subandhu; {#puzpavatyapi#}
 {#pavitrA, kfzRo'pyasudarSanaH, Barato'pi SatruGnaH#} being familiar instances);
 it is thus defined by Mammaṭa:-- {#viroDaH so'viroDe'pi virudDatvane#}
 {#yadvacaH#} <ls>K. P. 10</ls>; (this figure is also called {#viroDABAsa#}).
